Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00

; EA App — Per-game keys under publisher subfolders
; Real export: HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\EA Games\{gameName}\Install Dir

[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\EA Games\Dead Space 3]
"GDFBinary"=str(2):"GDFBinary.dll"
"DisplayName"=str(2):"Dead Space 3"
"Install Dir"=str(2):"PLACEHOLDER_EA_BASE/Games/Dead Space 3"
"Locale"=str(2):"en_US"
"Product GUID"=str(2):"{dead-space-3-guid}"

[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\EA Games\Mass Effect 3]
"GDFBinary"=str(2):"GDFBinary.dll"
"DisplayName"=str(2):"Mass Effect 3"
"Install Dir"=str(2):"PLACEHOLDER_EA_BASE/Games/Mass Effect 3"
"Locale"=str(2):"en_US"

; EA Desktop — launcher path only (NOT game install path)
[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Electronic Arts\EA Desktop]
"DesktopAppPath"=str(2):"C:\\Program Files\\Electronic Arts\\EA Desktop\\EADesktop.exe"
"LauncherAppPath"=str(2):"C:\\Program Files\\Electronic Arts\\EA Desktop\\EALauncher.exe"
"InstallLocation"=str(2):"C:\\Program Files\\Electronic Arts\\EA Desktop\\"
